## What I shaped and why

Iteration 0197 goes back to step 4 of the positive-control thread (#763 f4). In the last iteration, tool probe #842 (benchmark role) ran all 7 tools without error: Read, Grep, Glob, python3, git, Write and Edit ([.session/reports/842.json](.session/reports/842.json)). The "disabled for this session" blocks in #834 and #838 did not happen again, so they look intermittent and not tied to the benchmark role.

- `positive-control-author-0197` (benchmark, default model, medium effort, 60 min / 45 turns). This is the #838 body again: add wrong-literal and wrong-locator mutation controls for A0001 and A0002, answer F4 (the scheme name in the compared citation dict), regenerate `benchmark/results/challenges.json`, and update every pin. The session must test one Read and one Grep first. If either fails, it stops and reports.
- `positive-control-review-0197` (reviewer, default model, medium effort, 40 min / 30 turns) is `blocked_by` the author task. It does a changed-scope review, saves its pins first and writes findings to the report and to `.session/artifacts/review-0197.md`.

Expected gain: a CLEAR closes the positive-control thread. The next shaper checks the author's status in record 0197 and the first line of the reviewer's report.

`.session/tasks.json` passed the direct Python check for JSON, fields and headings (exit 0). I rewrote `journal/working-memory.md` with the four required sections.

## What next
- If the author task is blocked by tools again, do not order a fourth full attempt. Escalate to the Policymaker through `.session/suggestions.json`.
- If it ends partial but has a branch, order a finishing task with `start_branch` and at most 20 turns.
- After a CLEAR, move to the deferred gap: independent confirmation of the XML key.

## Discoveries
- Both 12-turn probes ended `partial` with cause `session_budget`, even though their tables were complete. Give future probes at least 16 turns ([record 0196](.session/history/records/0196.json)).
